steps: Begin ID capture > disable network > attempt upload
expected: Explicit offline message, nothing silently lost, retry available. No partial upload treated as success.

journey: Verification — the code length on screen matches the code sent

journey: Intake produces a usable starting program

expected: A program appears that respects every answer. No question is mandatory-looping, and the program is reachable in five steps.

journey: Intake left at its defaults still publishes a plan
steps: Accept every default without changing anything > continue
expected: A plan is still published. T06 has a card to show. An unanswered intake never leaves Home empty.

steps: Read the pre-filled weight and reps > tap the primary button once

journey: Undo a set within five seconds

expected: Set removed, state returns to pre-save. No confirmation dialog appears at any point.

journey: Log a whole move in one tap
precondition: Trained all three sets without the phone
steps: Tap 'I did all 3 sets — log them'
expected: All three sets save. Returns to R13 with that move struck through and the next one live. Session does NOT end.

journey: Log a session trained without the phone
precondition: Session completed away from the phone
steps: From Home tap 'I already did it' > tap Save on today's plan
expected: Two taps. Week credit applies. R12 awards fewer points and states no personal best was set.
rule_protected: Rule: recalled sessions never set a personal best

journey: Change a set value without a keyboard
steps: Tap Change > pick a weight chip > pick a reps chip > Save
expected: Two taps, no keyboard. Keyboard only if explicitly requested. A hard set never lowers her weight automatically.

journey: Log a usual meal in one tap
precondition: Has logged ful and baladi at least twice before
steps: Open Eat at lunchtime > tap Log on the top suggestion
expected: One tap. Slot fills, protein bar animates, running total updates. Snackbar with Undo. No calorie countdown anywhere.
rule_protected: Rule: calm running total, never a countdown

journey: Log a meal by typing a sentence
steps: Open the box > type 'koshari and 2 eggs' > confirm sizes > log
expected: Sentence parses into two items with sizes pre-picked, adjustable as chips on the row. Resolves with no network.

journey: Log a meal by voice in Egyptian Arabic
steps: Hold the mic > speak the meal in Egyptian dialect > review transcript > confirm
expected: Transcript shown before saving so a misheard word is visible. Interface stays MSA; speech input accepts dialect.

steps: Log a set and a meal offline > re-enable network
expected: Both save locally and appear immediately. They sync on reconnect with no duplicates and no data loss.
rule_protected: Offline-first requirement

journey: Logging the same planned meal twice corrects it; a second helping is separate
precondition: Lunch already logged from the plan
steps: Log the same planned lunch again > then separately choose 'another helping'
expected: The first repeat CORRECTS the existing log and does not double the total. The second helping adds a distinct item. Two different intents, two different outcomes.
rule_protected: HANDOFF rule 3

journey: Two devices offline log into the same meal slot
precondition: Same account on two devices, both offline, same day
steps: Log a different item into lunch on each device > bring both online
expected: Both items survive. Neither overwrites the other and the total reflects both. A plain document merge would lose one.
rule_protected: Spine C3 (amended): same-slot writes need arrayUnion/increment, not merge

journey: An unplanned walk or class is scored as unplanned
steps: Log a walk or a studio class from 'I already did it' > check the points awarded and the personal bests
expected: Saves with source 'unplanned'. Awards the same reduced points a recalled session gets, not full points, and is excluded from personal-best detection. Only source 'live' earns full credit.
rule_protected: Only a live session earns full credit or a personal best

journey: An award cannot be granted twice by an offline replay
precondition: A session finishing while the phone is offline
steps: Finish a session offline > let the queued write replay on reconnect
expected: Points are awarded exactly once and the total does not double. An increment is commutative but NOT idempotent, so the award must be bound to the creation of a deterministic awardId in the same transaction.
rule_protected: Spine C4 (corrected): an increment never travels alone

journey: The daily points cap holds even when several sessions sync at once
precondition: More sessions logged in one day than the cap allows
steps: Log several sessions in a single day, some offline, then sync
expected: Points stop at the daily cap. Logging offline and syncing several at once does not bypass it.

journey: A week repaired by a rest week pays no points
precondition: Weekly goal missed; one rest week banked
steps: Let the week close repaired > check points, the counted-week total, and progress toward the next rest week
expected: The counted-week total is protected and nothing earned is removed, but the repaired week awards no points and earns no progress toward the next rest week.
rule_protected: Rule 3 + nothing earned is taken away

journey: A measurement can be undone, and is never comparable

steps: Save a measurement > tap Undo within five seconds
expected: Removed, with no confirmation dialog. P04 stays private to her: no query reads measurements across users and the single-field index exemption makes the sort impossible.
rule_protected: Rule 9 + rule 11 + spine C7

precondition: A has one post 8 weeks old

journey: Blur — a photo post uploads blurred

expected: The stored bytes are already blurred. No unblurred object exists at any point in the pipeline. blurApplied is true on the post document.

journey: Blur — a reel exports blurred on Android
precondition: Android device with ML Kit face detection
steps: Record a 30-second reel with a face visible > publish > download the published file and step through it
expected: Every frame containing a face is blurred in the published file. The source clip is never uploaded and never written outside the app sandbox.

journey: Blur — a reel exports blurred on iOS
precondition: iOS device using the Vision framework
steps: Record a 30-second reel with a face visible > publish > download the published file and step through it
expected: Identical result to the Android path. Where the export is slower than the Android device the progress state is explicit; it never publishes an unblurred file to meet a deadline.
rule_protected: Rule 6 on video

journey: Blur — turning it off is explicit and recorded
steps: Turn blur off for one image > publish > inspect the post document
expected: The opt-out applies to that image only. blurOptOut records who and when. The next composition starts with blur on again.

steps: Like a post > like it again > re-enable the network
expected: Exactly one like exists. The count converges to the server's value and never double-counts. The like document id is her uid so the replay is the same document.
rule_protected: Spine C1 + C4

steps: Write a comment > re-enable the network
expected: The comment shows immediately at full opacity with the queued glyph, syncs once, and no duplicate appears. No blocking spinner and no failure message.
rule_protected: G8 offline contract

journey: Publish offline holds the media locally
steps: Compose a photo post > publish > inspect other accounts > re-enable the network
expected: Her own feed and profile show the post badged as waiting. No post document exists for anyone else until the media upload completes. Nothing appears in another woman's feed pointing at a missing object.
rule_protected: Media-before-document ordering

journey: Block — what she can and cannot see
precondition: A and B both verified, B blocks A
steps: As A: open the feed > open B's profile > attempt to comment on and like B's post > attempt to follow B
expected: A never sees B in her surfaces and every blocked surface reads 'not available'. Comment, like and follow are refused by security rules, not merely hidden. Nothing anywhere tells A she has been blocked.

journey: Report from a post — queued offline

expected: Says it is not sent yet and that the hour starts when it sends. It is never rendered as 'a moderator is reading it'. It sends once on reconnect.

steps: Wait past the TTL > refresh the rail > request the media URL directly

journey: An unverified or pledge-stale account cannot enter

precondition: Account with a name, weight, photos and cycle data recorded

journey: Assistant — the API key never ships

expected: No key is present in any artefact. All model calls originate from the Cloud Function. FAILS if a key or a direct api.anthropic.com call exists in the app.

journey: Assistant — the endpoint rejects what it should

expected: All three are rejected before any model call. Errors are unauthenticated, failed-precondition and failed-precondition respectively. Zero tokens are spent in all three cases.

journey: Assistant — a coach cannot reach a client she does not coach

journey: Assistant — the cached prefix is actually being read
precondition: Two identical-prefix requests within the TTL

expected: The second response reports cache_read_input_tokens greater than zero covering the whole shared prefix. FAILS if it stays zero, which means something in the prefix varies per request.
rule_protected: Cost control depends on a stable prefix

steps: Ask an ordinary in-scope question

journey: Assistant — the word AI is absent

journey: Set up My cycle — dates and symptoms
precondition: Verified account with no cycle document
steps: Open My cycle from Home > choose 'Track periods and symptoms' > continue > enter a last period start > save preferences
expected: Y03 opens showing the day she logged, labelled 'Logged by you'. Usual cycle length stays 'Not sure' — nothing pre-fills 28 days. All three sharing switches are off.
rule_protected: Sharing switches default off; no invented cycle length

journey: Set up My cycle — symptom-only mode
precondition: Verified account with no cycle document
steps: Open My cycle > choose 'Track symptoms only' > continue
expected: The hub renders the symptom-only state: no calendar tab, no estimate, no phase name, no cycle ring. Her planned workout is shown unchanged. Y14 is a state of the hub route, never a separate destination.
rule_protected: No phase and no forecast without dates

journey: Skipping setup leaves the app exactly as it was
precondition: Verified account with no cycle document
steps: Open My cycle > tap 'Skip setup' > return to Home
expected: No cycle document is written. Home shows no cycle card, no check-in prompt and no trace of the feature. Nothing elsewhere in the app changes.
rule_protected: F80: My cycle is optional, and skipping costs nothing

journey: Daily check-in — three taps and nothing carried over
precondition: Cycle set up; a check-in with severe cramps was saved yesterday
steps: Open 'How are you feeling?' > observe the initial state > log energy okay and cramps none > save
expected: Every chip starts unselected — yesterday's severe cramps do not prefill today. The save takes three taps, all optional, and the hub returns to her unchanged plan.
rule_protected: Nothing is carried over from yesterday

journey: A logged symptom changes the suggestion — a date never does
precondition: Cycle set up with a period logged as starting yesterday
steps: Log low energy and mild cramps > open the gentler card > tap 'Why this suggestion?'
expected: The gentler option appears and its reason names what she logged — low energy, mild cramps, today only. The period day is stated as a fact and never given as a reason. 'Keep mine' leaves the planned session untouched.
rule_protected: Suggestions follow logged symptoms, never an inferred phase

journey: Severe symptoms remove the workout suggestion entirely
steps: Log severe cramps > save the check-in
expected: The hub shows medical guidance and a route to care. No workout, no gentler option and no meal-based answer appears anywhere on the screen, including the Train entry row. A rest row is offered and is not framed as a failure.
rule_protected: Severe symptoms replace the workout suggestion

journey: Route to care — Android including the fallback
precondition: Android device with severe symptoms logged
steps: Tap 'Find care near you' > then repeat with no maps application installed and with no network
expected: With maps present it opens a geo intent. With none, or offline, a bundled list with an emergency number renders in-app and is dialable. The screen never dead-ends and never shows a raw error.
rule_protected: A route to care always exists

journey: Route to care — iOS including the fallback
precondition: iOS device with severe symptoms logged
steps: Tap 'Find care near you' > then repeat with Maps restricted by Screen Time and with no network
expected: Maps opens when available; otherwise the same bundled in-app list and dialable emergency number render. Parity with Android is verified, not assumed.
rule_protected: A route to care always exists

journey: Log a period then correct it
precondition: Cycle set up in dates-and-symptoms mode
steps: Log a period starting three days ago with 'still bleeding' > save > reopen it > set an end date of yesterday > save
expected: Both saves land. The calendar shows the days as logged. The still-bleeding flag clears when the end date is set — the two can never disagree. Estimates are recomputed from the corrected dates.
rule_protected: A period can be added and edited

journey: Impossible dates are refused rather than stored
steps: Attempt a start date in the future > then an end date earlier than the start
expected: Each is refused on screen with the reason, before any write is attempted. No document is created, so there is nothing to undo and nothing to sync.
rule_protected: Future dates and end-before-start are rejected

journey: Delete a period and the estimates built on it
precondition: A period logged two cycles ago
steps: Open that period > delete it > return to the calendar
expected: The period disappears from the calendar and the next-period estimate is recomputed without it. The pattern counts on Your patterns fall accordingly. No stale estimate survives.
rule_protected: Editing or deleting a date clears estimates built on it

journey: Logged and estimated are distinguishable without colour
steps: View the month > enable grayscale and a screen reader
expected: Logged days are solid with a text label, estimates are dashed and labelled 'est.'. Colour is never the only signal. The estimate is stated as a range with its reason, and no day is labelled confirmed ovulation.
rule_protected: Estimates are never presented as facts

journey: Sharing is off by default and each switch is independent
precondition: Active coaching relationship; cycle set up
steps: Open cycle settings > observe > turn on 'Energy and appetite' only
expected: All three start off. Turning one on leaves the other two off. The preview states exactly what the coach would see. Coaching never required any of them.
rule_protected: Sharing switches are independent and default off

journey: Revoking a switch removes the coach's derived panel
precondition: Cycle sharing on for energy and appetite; coach signed in
steps: Turn the switch off > reload the coach's client screen and her weekly review
expected: The coach's wellbeing panel shows 'not shared' rather than an empty panel or a zero. The derived row disappears from the weekly review. Nothing cached on the coach's device still renders the old values.
rule_protected: Turning a switch off revokes the coach's derived panels

journey: Cycle sharing ends with the coaching relationship
precondition: A finished coaching relationship that had cycle sharing on
steps: End or expire the relationship > open the coach's view of that client > open cycle settings as the client
expected: The coach sees 'not shared' with no further action by the client. The client's settings show the switches off. A new relationship with a different coach does not inherit the grant.
rule_protected: A grant never survives the relationship it was given for

journey: Delete cycle data without touching the rest of the app
precondition: Cycle set up with periods and check-ins logged
steps: Open cycle settings > 'Delete cycle data' > confirm
expected: The cycle document and every period are deleted. Workouts, meals, rewards and week counting are untouched. The screen states plainly what was deleted and what was kept, and the feature returns to its not-set-up state.
rule_protected: F88: cycle data is deletable on its own

journey: Offline — a period and a check-in save with no signal
steps: Log a period > log a check-in > reopen the calendar > restore the network
expected: Both save locally and render at full opacity with a queued glyph. No spinner, no error, no disabled control. Both sync on reconnect with no duplicate document and no second period.
rule_protected: Logging never requires signal; a replay creates no duplicate

journey: Meal options follow symptoms and adding is not eating
precondition: Cycle set up; sesame allergy recorded; more hunger logged today
steps: Open the meal options from the cycle hub > add one to the plan
expected: At most three options, none containing sesame, each with its reason written on the card. Adding updates today's plan and does not log the meal as eaten — the count of logged meals is unchanged.
rule_protected: Allergies are applied before ranking; adding is not logging

steps: Inspect the import graph and the signature of the only function that produces a suggestion, then log high energy and no cramps on period day 2
expected: No suggestion path can reach a cycle phase: the resolver takes today's check-in and nothing else, and the phase estimator is not importable outside the calendar's presentation folder. The usual strength session stays.

steps: Log severe cramps and inspect the suppressed result type

steps: Create a fresh cycle document; then grant one switch, revoke it, and end the relationship
expected: A new document has every sharing switch false. Setting one never sets another. Revocation and a finished relationship both make the projection 'not shared' at read time, with no revocation write required.
rule_protected: Sharing switches are independent, default off, and revoke on the way out

precondition: App built and running with a network capture attached
steps: Exercise every cycle screen — set up, check in, log a period, open patterns, change sharing — and inspect every analytics payload and the feature's call sites
expected: No cycle or symptom datum reaches analytics in any form, including as a bucketed integer. The cycle feature contains zero analytics call sites; only G8's router screen views are emitted.

steps: Inspect firestore.indexes.json, then attempt a collection-group query over periods and a cross-user read of another woman's cycle document
